Warriors 88Celtics 87

Podziemski's late three edges Boston

Final · Sun, Nov 22 · Golden State

The Warriors trailed by 11 in the third, went ahead on Brandin Podziemski’s three with 2:38 left, and held on when Jayson Tatum’s last shot missed.
